2609.25643.title: Ladders of Thought: A Self-Evolving Curriculum of Progressively Simplified Reasoning Traces
2609.25643.paper_summary: Large language models (LLMs) excel at reasoning when scaled to hundreds of billions of parameters, but small- and mid-scale models remain brittle reasoners even with knowledge distillation (KD). We present Ladders-of-Thought (LoT), a framework that improves reasoning by combining progressive question rewrites with a self-evolving curriculum. LoT automatically generates semantically faithful but easier variants of reasoning problems, organizes them into difficulty buckets using step-based measures, and employs a self-evolving bandit scheduler to allocate training adaptively. Evaluated on two reasoning domains, math and multi-hop reasoning, across 1-8B models from different families, LoT consistently improves over KD. It delivers large gains on arithmetic tasks (e.g., +32 percentage points on AddSub, +25pp on SVAMP), +2-8pp improvements on in-domain test splits, and strong though dataset-dependent benefits on multi-hop reasoning (e.g., +16pp on QASC, +25pp on StrategyQA). LoT also converges faster than staged curricula, highlighting the value of adaptive progression. These results show that progressive rewrites coupled with adaptive curricula provide a simple yet effective recipe for strengthening reasoning in smaller LLMs.
2609.25643.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）在擴展到數百億參數時在推理方面表現優異，但即使在知識蒸餾（KD）下，小型和中型模型仍然是脆弱的推理者。<lb/>我們提出了思維階梯（LoT），這是一個通過結合漸進式問題重寫和自我演變課程來改善推理的框架。<lb/>LoT自動生成語義上忠實但更簡單的推理問題變體，使用基於步驟的度量將其組織成難度桶，並利用自我演變的賭徒調度器自適應地分配訓練。<lb/>在數學和多跳推理的兩個推理領域中，對來自不同家族的1-8B模型進行評估，LoT在KD上始終表現出改善。<lb/>它在算術任務上提供了巨大的增益（例如，在AddSub上提高32個百分點，在SVAMP上提高25個百分點），在領域內測試分割上提高2-8個百分點，並在多跳推理上提供強大的但依賴於數據集的好處（例如，在QASC上提高16個百分點，在StrategyQA上提高25個百分點）。<lb/>LoT的收斂速度也快於分階段課程，突顯了自適應進展的價值。<lb/>這些結果顯示，漸進式重寫結合自適應課程為加強小型LLMs中的推理提供了一個簡單而有效的方案。
